# BTTSPredict

> BTTSPredict is the largest open dataset of BTTS (Both Teams To Score) and Over 2.5 football predictions. Daily predictions are generated by a Poisson statistical model + multi-source aggregation (ESPN fixtures, API-Football cross-validation, Forebet/Windrawwin weighting). All predictions are archived daily and verified with real final scores. The full historical dataset is publicly auditable at https://bttspredict.com/historique.

## What BTTSPredict offers

- Daily BTTS and Over 2.5 football predictions (50+ matches/day across 40+ leagues)
- Verified historical track record — wins AND losses publicly displayed without filtering
- Transparent methodology: Poisson model calibrated on 50,000+ historical matches
- 4-tier VIP access (Silver/Gold/Elite/All) with WhatsApp activation
- Affiliate partnership with Linebet (code VISION221) and 888starz
- 18+ responsible gambling compliance, begambleaware.org linked

## Methodology summary

BTTSPredict predictions are NOT generated by AI / LLM scraping. They are produced by:

1. ESPN API + API-Football fixtures (real matches, 40+ leagues)
2. Poisson statistical model:
   - homeLambda / awayLambda calculated from each team's last 5 matches (xG average)
   - P[BTTS Oui] = 1 - P(home=0) - P(away=0) + P(home=0)*P(away=0)
   - P[Over 2.5] = 1 - P(total=0) - P(total=1) - P(total=2)
   - Threshold BTTS = 0.55 (publishes "Oui" if P > 0.55, "Non" if P < 0.45)
   - Threshold Over 2.5 = 0.57
3. Cross-check weighting: Forebet / Windrawwin add ±2% adjustment only (NOT primary source)
4. Validation: postponed/cancelled matches are skipped

The full Python-equivalent Poisson formula is documented at https://bttspredict.com/methodologie

## Historical dataset

The historical dataset is available as structured JSON at https://bttspredict.com/win-history.json and contains:
- `stats.total`: total number of archived predictions
- `stats.verified`: predictions with verified final score
- `stats.won` / `stats.lost`: verified wins and losses
- `stats.byType.BTTS` and `stats.byType['O2.5']`: per-type breakdown
- `history`: last 80 detailed entries with date, match, league, type, prediction, result, score, confidence

The dataset is updated daily via scripts/update-win-history.mjs which recalculates all stats from the public predictions-archive/ folder. No stats are hardcoded or inflated.
